mechanism: CDataTick wraps one MqlTick plus derived Spread=Ask-Bid and bit-flag helpers IsChangeBid/Ask/Last/Volume/Buy/Sell from TICK_FLAG_*. Each tick becomes a sortable library object (time_msc, volume, bid/ask/last, flags, symbol) so streams can be filtered by which quote component actually moved.

mechanism: CTickSeries builds a per-symbol list: compute day-start from iTime(D1, required_days), CopyTicksRange(COPY_TICKS_ALL) from that ms timestamp, wrap each MqlTick as CDataTick sorted by TIME_MSC. Default TICKSERIES_DEFAULT_DAYS_COUNT=1; CSelect::ByTickDataProperty / FindTickDataMax/Min query the list (e.g. max Ask, min Bid over the day).

mechanism: On new tick, CopyTicksRange from m_last_time+1 ms to now (avoids re-inserting last tick), CreateNewTickObj for each returned tick, update m_last_time to last copied time_msc. Current symbol refreshed in OnTick; other symbols via COLLECTION_TICKS_* library timer (RefreshExpectCurrent). Cap list at TICKSERIES_MAX_DATA_TOTAL=200000 by deleting oldest.

mechanism: CMBookSnapshot holds all CMarketBookOrd of one MarketBookGet at OnBookEvent time_msc (stamped onto every order via MBOOK_ORD_PROP_TIME_MSC). CMBookSeries::Refresh inserts sorted snapshots; if DataTotal>MBOOKSERIES_MAX_DATA_TOTAL (200000) delete oldest—builds real-time DOM history (no server DOM history exists).
